mainEntity.name: What is new in ACOS v10?

acceptedAnswer.text: Autonomous swarm intelligence, dynamic tool selection, real-time memory synchronization, and built-in brand voice enforcement.

mainEntity.name: How does ACOS v10 handle tool routing?

acceptedAnswer.text: It automatically routes tool calls to the most efficient MCP server based on task classification and context availability.

mainEntity.name: Can ACOS v10 run locally without cloud dependencies?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. ACOS executes in local terminal environments using local files, local tools, and direct model API connections.

mainEntity.name: What quality gates does ACOS v10 enforce?

acceptedAnswer.text: TypeScript compilation, schema validation, link integrity, and strict taste/brand contract audits.

mainEntity.name: Where can I find the ACOS v10 source repository?

acceptedAnswer.text: The source is hosted openly on GitHub under the frankxai organization.
